title: LCRB manufacturer licence and distribution rules
plain_language_summary: Selling alcohol into BC requires a licence from the Liquor and Cannabis Regulation Branch, and distribution generally has to run through BC's structured liquor distribution model.
raw_requirement_text: A manufacturer must hold a valid licence from the Liquor and Cannabis Regulation Branch before manufacturing or distributing liquor for sale in British Columbia.

title: Federal meat inspection for interprovincial sale
plain_language_summary: Same federal requirement nationwide: meat crossing a provincial line needs CFIA inspection.
raw_requirement_text: Meat products moved in interprovincial trade require inspection under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations administered by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency.

title: National Safety Code (NSC) carrier registration, BC
plain_language_summary: Commercial carriers need a National Safety Code number registered through BC's system, and safety fitness certificates carry province-specific record requirements.
raw_requirement_text: Operators of commercial vehicles in British Columbia must maintain a National Safety Code carrier profile administered under the Commercial Transport Act.
authority: BC Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure

title: BC regulatory body registration
plain_language_summary: Regulated professions require registration with the relevant BC regulator, BC's Economic Stabilization (Interprovincial Trade) legislation has expanded automatic recognition of comparable out-of-province credentials.
raw_requirement_text: Individuals practising a regulated profession in British Columbia must register with the applicable BC regulatory body, subject to recognition provisions under BC's interprovincial trade legislation.
authority: Relevant BC regulatory college (varies by profession)
